prompt_text: I am planning a trip. Should I book on Airbnb, Vrbo, or Booking.com, and how do I find a good host?
ai_overview_text:
Airbnb: Best for unique stays, global coverage, individual rooms or whole homes, and active host-guest communication. Features a Superhost program for verified quality. Guest service fees typically range from 10% to 13%. Mashvisor +1
Vrbo: Best for entire homes, families, and larger groups. Owned by Expedia Group, it specializes strictly in whole-property rentals rather than shared spaces. Guest service fees run around 10% to 11%. YouTube·TPF! Travel Plus +2
Booking.com: Best for a mix of hotels, apartments, and commercial properties. Guest service fees are typically 0% (the host pays a higher commission), meaning upfront prices can sometimes appear lower, though communication is more centralized/commercial rather than social. Reservations on Booking.com are often instantly confirmed without manual host screening. Mashvisor +3
session_note: Organic results extracted mechanically from the returned results page. Bright Data does not document an AI Overview field, so ai_overview_detected is BEST EFFORT and may be null. Do not publish it as a measurement.
